ticket.summary: Steady drip from spout of original 1990s bathroom faucet, no leaks under sink; cartridge replacement booked.
mitigation_advice: Close the small oval shutoff valve on the supply line under the sink, clockwise until snug, to stop the drip overnight [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Faucet/shower cartridge replacement - old (1990s) bathroom faucet

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Grace - see you tomorrow! Booked: Mon Sep 1, 10:30 AM at 16 Weaver Court, faucet cartridge replacement, $159 flat rate (~70 min). If the drip turns out to be something other than the cartridge, the tech will walk you through options before doing any extra work. And yes - shutting that under-sink valve tonight should buy you some sleep.
